name: landing-page
description: Single-file responsive HTML landing page (inline CSS/JS, no build step)
goal: Build a single-file landing page (index.html) for: {topic}. Style: {style}.
constraints: One self-contained index.html: inline CSS and JS, no external requests, no frameworks, no build step. Responsive, accessible (semantic HTML, alt text, good contrast). Placeholder copy must be plausible, no fake testimonials with real names.
done_when: index.html exists, is valid standalone HTML with a hero, 3 feature sections and a call-to-action, and renders without network access.
